title: Your Beer Just Got a Chance to Be on the Stock Market: Understanding Carlsberg India's IPO Plans
description: Carlsberg A/S is planning to launch an Initial Public Offering (IPO) for its India business. This IPO could raise around US$600 million (approximately ₹5,010 .

faq.q: What is Carlsberg India's market position?
faq.a: Carlsberg India is currently the second-largest brewer in India. As of fiscal year 2026, it held a 21.9% market share across 16 key states and union territories.

faq.q: What is a "roadshow" in an IPO?
faq.a: A roadshow is a series of presentations by the company's management and investment bankers to potential institutional investors. It's a marketing effort to generate interest and demand for the shares before the IPO officially opens.

faq.q: Will this IPO bring new money into Carlsberg India's business?
faq.a: No, because this is an "Offer for Sale" (OFS). The money raised from selling the shares will go to the current shareholder, Carlsberg A/S (the Danish parent company), not directly to Carlsberg India for its operations or expansion.

faq.q: When can I expect the IPO to open for public subscription?
faq.a: While investor meetings are starting next week, the actual IPO launch for public subscription could be as early as January 2027. The exact dates will be announced closer to the launch.

faq.q: How much revenue did Carlsberg India report recently?
faq.a: Carlsberg India reported revenue of ₹87.09 billion for the fiscal year that ended on March 31, 2026.
